answer.explanation: The domain entity Order imports the TypeORM package and uses its @Entity() decorator, so the domain layer depends on a persistence framework. FF-DT04 flags this because domain code should stay free of infrastructure and framework dependencies. The project documents this as a known legacy exception: a comment on line 1 and a row in docs/legacy-exceptions.md allow the TypeORM decorator on this file until 2026-12-31, when the ORM mapping moves to infrastructure. Today is 2026-10-22, so the exception has not expired.

citation.quote: | src/ordering/domain/order/Order.ts | domain purity: TypeORM decorator on Order | 2026-12-31 | the ORM mapping moves to infrastructure in the persistence split |
